findings.historical_2017: Required staff to establish direct deposit within the first two weeks of employment.
findings.current_2025: Current handbook independently retains the first-two-weeks direct-deposit requirement.
findings.implication: Historical blank Direct Deposit Form is still relevant as a form lineage source, but current form/version must control.

findings.historical_2017: Eligible active full-time employees were generally eligible on the first day of the month after 60 days, subject to timely enrollment and employee contribution.
findings.current_2025: Current handbook-derived benefits record retains first-of-month-after-60-days eligibility.
findings.implication: Eligibility cadence appears stable; carrier/broker/admin systems changed substantially.

findings.historical_2017: Two hours per pay period, max six days per year, eligible after 30 days, stated max accrual 60 days.
findings.current_2025: Current handbook-derived leave policy preserves the same core accrual structure.
findings.implication: This is strong longitudinal evidence for the basic accrual rule, but current exceptions/administration remain governed by 2025 policy.

findings.historical_2017: Historical tenure-based vacation schedule and two-week advance request requirement.
findings.current_2025: Current handbook remains the controlling source; historical tiers/approval details must not be assumed without matching current text.
findings.implication: Keep 2017 schedule as historical version evidence only.

findings.historical_2017: FMLA and workers compensation ran concurrently; immediate injury reporting to supervisor/person in charge/HR was required.
findings.current_2025: Current handbook independently preserves immediate injury reporting and FMLA concurrency.
findings.implication: Workflow skeleton is strongly corroborated across versions, though current carrier/forms and statutory details still need current validation.

findings.historical_2017: Legacy attendance policy used a 10-point termination threshold.
findings.current_2025: Current handbook uses partial-day point values and termination at 6 points, with current warning/suspension thresholds.
findings.implication: Never use the 2017 10-point framework for current attendance decisions. Scanner/Agent OS should label legacy attendance documents by effective period.

findings.historical_2017: Grouped A-D infraction framework with escalating counseling/suspension/discharge patterns.
findings.current_2025: Later handbook/policy records contain a different current framework and separate attendance-point logic.
findings.implication: 2017 disciplinary groups are historical classification evidence only and should not drive current discipline.

findings.historical_2017: EEO Program implementation assigned to Sheila Stallsworth.
findings.current_2026: Later sources establish an effective-dated EEO Officer history and the signed 2026 policy assigns the current role-holder.
findings.implication: Named-role assignments must be effective-dated; never answer current EEO-owner questions from old handbooks.

findings.historical_2017: Handbook referenced the benefit structure of its era; 2016-2018 email attachments show older carrier/broker implementations.
findings.current_2026: Current evidence shows Guardian, UnitedHealthcare, ComPsych, iSolved/Infinisource and ADP-linked processes.
findings.implication: Policy concepts may persist while provider/system instructions are versioned and time-sensitive.

findings.historical_2017: General work-related grievance path began with supervisor and escalated to Executive Director.
findings.current_2025_2026: Current harassment/EEO sources explicitly include HR/EEO roles and later signed EEO authority.
findings.implication: Use current complaint/EEO/harassment sources rather than the historical general grievance route when scopes overlap.

findings.historical_2017: Broad restrictions on personal cell-phone use, camera/video use and transmission of company information.
findings.current_2025: Currentness of the exact 2017 wording has not been independently established in this pass.
findings.implication: Do not enforce historical camera/device language without checking current policy.

findings.historical_2017: Broad restriction on employment of defined relatives and reassignment/separation path for conflicts.
findings.current_2025: Exact current rule not established by the attachment analysis.
findings.implication: Preserve as historical evidence; verify current handbook before use.

design_rules: Policy-version comparisons should distinguish stable principles from stable operational details.
Named people, thresholds, vendors, forms and system instructions are especially likely to change and must be effective-dated.
When a later source conflicts with an older handbook, the older version remains historical evidence rather than being deleted.
